intro: God Is Able International Ministry is blessed to announce that we have t-shirts available. Every time someone buys a t-shirt, we bless someone in need with a free t-shirt. Grab one for your friend, family member, colleague or yourself. Bless someone and be blessed.
verse: Each of you should give what you have decided in your heart to give, not reluctantly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver. And God is able to bless you abundantly, so that in all things at all times, having all that you need, you will abound in every good work.

products.name: God Is Able T-shirt
products.description: 100% cotton t-shirts. We pray over our t-shirts before sending them out, to stand as a symbol of fellowship, love and sharing with others. Comes in all sizes and colors — grab yours now. Tell us your size, color and design in the order note.
